texts.label: text
texts.orig: This Service Agreement (the "Agreement") is made on 1 March 2026 between Northwind Analytics AS, Oslo, Norway (the "Supplier"), and Riverbank Logistics Ltd, Leeds, United Kingdom (the "Customer").
texts.text: This Service Agreement (the "Agreement") is made on 1 March 2026 between Northwind Analytics AS, Oslo, Norway (the "Supplier"), and Riverbank Logistics Ltd, Leeds, United Kingdom (the "Customer").

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: 1.Services
texts.text: 1.Services

texts.label: text
texts.orig: 1.1 The Supplier shall provide hosting, monitoring and support for the data platform of the Customer, as described in this Agreement.
texts.text: 1.1 The Supplier shall provide hosting, monitoring and support for the data platform of the Customer, as described in this Agreement.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: 1.2 Support is available on business days from o8:0o to 18:00 CET. Critical incidents are answered within 2 hours.
texts.text: 1.2 Support is available on business days from o8:0o to 18:00 CET. Critical incidents are answered within 2 hours.

texts.label: text

texts.orig: 3. Term and Termination
texts.text: 3. Term and Termination

texts.label: text
texts.orig: 3.1 This Agreement has an initial term of 24 months. It renews automatically for successive periods of 12 months, unless terminated.
texts.text: 3.1 This Agreement has an initial term of 24 months. It renews automatically for successive periods of 12 months, unless terminated.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: 3.2 Either party may terminate this Agreement by written notice of at least 90 days before the end of the current term.
texts.text: 3.2 Either party may terminate this Agreement by written notice of at least 90 days before the end of the current term.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: 3.3 The Supplier may suspend the services if an invoice is more than 45 days overdue.
texts.text: 3.3 The Supplier may suspend the services if an invoice is more than 45 days overdue.
